method.measured_boundary: executeSql through await; includes planning at submission, startup, processing, JNI, both transposes, state and completion
method.native_proof: plan requires native windows and both transposes; consumed native windows >= 2 and one recordsIn equals input rows
method.metadata_scope: Method applies to the matched final and baseline mimalloc runs. Earlier system-allocator diagnostics are labeled per run and are not production before/after evidence.
method.final_default_admission: Fixed-grid attached ONE_PHASE over ordinary COUNT-only upstream windows, size at most five slides/steps; no regional calendar callback. Wider overlap remains fallback unless the existing override is true.

flink_2_2_1_jdk_11.note: One new host three-stage TWO_PHASE/RocksDB fixture initially lacked managed memory; all 44 new cases pass after assigning 256 MiB to both engines.

criterion.allocator: CountingAllocator delegates to System; separate from the mimalloc whole-job measurements
criterion.boundary: Four update/non-closing-watermark pairs (0, 100, 200, 300), then final firing; database/input construction outside timing. Every deferred write is included. Allocation requests are from a separate untimed call, exclude native C/C++ allocations, and do not measure copied bytes or RSS.
